# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of **Watq** is actively maintained with security patches.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

The Watq team takes security, user privacy, and client-side confidentiality seriously.

If you believe you have discovered a vulnerability or security flaw, please report it through **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting**:

1. Navigate to the [Watq Security Advisories](https://github.com/Mafrilearth/watq/security/advisories) page.
2. Click **"Report a vulnerability"** to submit an advisory privately.
3. Provide a clear description, reproduction steps, and any relevant proof-of-concept.

Alternatively, you may contact the core maintainers via email at:  
`security@mafrilearth.com`

### Our Commitment
- We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within **48 hours**.
- We will provide regular status updates regarding verification and triage.
- Once fixed, we will publish an advisory crediting your responsible disclosure.

Please do **NOT** open public issues or pull requests detailing undisclosed vulnerabilities.
